changes: Grade ranges use the midpoint palette; C–A matches B and D–B matches C. Half-band midpoints blend the two neighboring palette colors.
Style checks detect a native white reset even if the grade label is unchanged; same-style redraws do not call SetExtraInfo again.
Focus callbacks retain original argc, flags, parameters and register counts and can attach through a fingerprint-gated body accessor when native setup is bypassed.
Ordinary script accessor fast path does not allocate, log, query process memory or increment counters.

Prospect List Class cells use native row-key serialization and the verified native parser to match persistent recruit associations. Typed row properties and original getter arguments are forwarded unchanged.
Class-cell lookup is deferred until the native row getter returns, avoiding data-source reentry in collector callbacks.
Prospect List side panel receives the same class label and masks Playing Time text and its UI-only comparison values, preserving other motivations and eligibility.
Grid collector is bypassed entirely for column sets without Class column 15; non-JC strings are checked without allocation.
